settings.text: A structured top-handle tote in matte, translucent jelly. Lightweight, wipe-clean, and impossible to ignore — in fifteen candy-bright shades.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: Designed for the woman who treats a Tuesday like an event, the Jelly Tote takes a classic top-handle silhouette and remakes it in matte, translucent jelly. A scalloped front flap, a polished silver turn-lock, and tall top handles that sit easily in the hand or on the shoulder give it real structure — while the candy-bright finish keeps it light, playful, and impossible to miss. It's roomy enough for everything a day asks for and moves from beach club to brunch without missing a beat. Best of all, the jelly wipes clean and shrugs off the weather, so it keeps its shine season after season. Available in fifteen shades — collect your favorite, or every one.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Body: Matte, translucent jelly PVC.
Hardware: Polished silver turn-lock with padlock and key.
Handles: Tall top handles in matching jelly.
Closure: Scalloped front flap with belt strap.

Care: Wipe clean with a soft, damp cloth — no special products needed. Weather-friendly and water-resistant; simply dry after a rainy day. Store out of prolonged direct heat to keep the jelly's shine.

settings.title: Dimensions & Fit
settings.content:
Width: 35 cm (13.8")  |  Height: 27 cm (10.6")  |  Depth: 15 cm (5.9")  |  Handle Drop: 23 cm (9")

What it fits: a tablet, full-size wallet, sunglasses, a water bottle, and your daily essentials — with the tall handles clearing the shoulder.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.
